verdict.rationale: Spline is a cloud SaaS design tool whose files 'live in the cloud', so data residency is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never mentions any region or residency selection. The Self-Hosted export only packages a finished scene for deployment and does not let users choose where their editor data is stored, so it is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
